name: Issue Summary

on:
#  schedule:
#    - cron: "0 8 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - feat/models

permissions:
  issues: write
  contents: read
  models: read

jobs:
  create_weekly_summary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      REPO: romdhanisam/Triage-Party-With-Agentic-Workflows 
      REPO_REPORT_ISSUE_CREATION: romdhanisam/Triage-Party-With-Agentic-Workflows 
      SUMMARY_ISSUE_TITLE: Issue Summary - 4+ Year-Old Open Issues
      REPORT_MODEL: ${{ vars.ISSUE_SUMMARY_MODEL || 'openai/gpt-4.1-mini' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install gh-models extension
        run: gh extension install https://github.com/github/gh-models || gh extension upgrade gh-models

      - name: Collect open issues older than 4 years
        id: collect
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          ISSUES_ENABLED="$(gh repo view "$REPO" --json hasIssuesEnabled --jq '.hasIssuesEnabled')"
          echo "issues_enabled=${ISSUES_ENABLED}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ "$ISSUES_ENABLED" != "true" ]; then
            echo "Issues are disabled for $REPO. Skipping summary generation."
            echo "cutoff_date=n/a" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "issue_count=0" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            printf '[]' > old_issues.json
            printf '' > issues_context.md
            exit 0
          fi

          CUTOFF_DATE="$(date -u -d '4 years ago' +%Y-%m-%d)"
          echo "cutoff_date=${CUTOFF_DATE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          gh issue list \
            --repo "$REPO" \
            --state open \
            --limit 500 \
            --search "created:<${CUTOFF_DATE} sort:created-asc" \
            --json number,title,body,url,createdAt,updatedAt,labels,assignees \
            > old_issues.json

          ISSUE_COUNT="$(jq 'length' old_issues.json)"
          echo "issue_count=${ISSUE_COUNT}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          jq -r '
            sort_by(.createdAt) |
            .[] |
            "### #\(.number) \(.title)\n" +
            "- URL: \(.url)\n" +
            "- Created: \(.createdAt)\n" +
            "- Updated: \(.updatedAt)\n" +
            "- Labels: " + (((.labels // []) | map(.name) | join(", ")) | if . == "" then "none" else . end) + "\n" +
            "- Assignees: " + (((.assignees // []) | map(.login) | join(", ")) | if . == "" then "none" else . end) + "\n" +
            "- Body excerpt: " + ((.body // "" | gsub("\r"; "") | gsub("\n"; " ") | gsub("\\s+"; " ") | .[0:500])) + "\n"
          ' old_issues.json > issues_context.md

      - name: Generate summary with GitHub Models
        if: steps.collect.outputs.issues_enabled == 'true'
        id: summarize
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ "${{ steps.collect.outputs.issue_count }}" = "0" ]; then
            cat > ai_summary.md <<'EOF'
          ## Open Issues Requiring Attention
          No open issues older than 4 years were found.

          ## Actionable Next Steps
          1. Keep this report running weekly.
          2. Re-check issues that cross the 4-year threshold.
          EOF
            echo "used_fallback=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          cat > prompt.txt <<'EOF'
          You are helping maintainers triage old GitHub issues.
          Return ONLY markdown with exactly these two sections, in this order:

          ## Open Issues Requiring Attention
          ## Actionable Next Steps

          Requirements:
          - Use only issues provided below.
          - Focus on open issues that are at least 4 years old.
          - In "Open Issues Requiring Attention", provide a prioritized bullet list (max 10) with issue number and markdown link.
          - In "Actionable Next Steps", provide a concise numbered plan with concrete actions.
          - Keep output concise (max ~320 words).
          - Do not add extra headings, intro, or outro.

          Issues:
          EOF
          cat issues_context.md >> prompt.txt

          if gh models run "$REPORT_MODEL" --temperature 0.2 --max-tokens 900 "$(cat prompt.txt)" > ai_summary.md 2>models_error.log; then
            echo "used_fallback=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "Model call failed. Building deterministic fallback summary."
            cat > ai_summary.md <<'EOF'
          ## Open Issues Requiring Attention
          EOF

            jq -r '
              sort_by(.createdAt) |
              .[0:10] |
              .[] |
              "- [#\(.number) \(.title)](\(.url)) — open since \(.createdAt[0:10]), last updated \(.updatedAt[0:10])."
            ' old_issues.json >> ai_summary.md

            cat >> ai_summary.md <<'EOF'

          ## Actionable Next Steps
          1. Triage the top 3 oldest issues and decide: close, reproduce, or plan.
          2. Add or refresh labels (`bug`, `enhancement`, `needs-info`, `help wanted`) for each prioritized issue.
          3. Assign an owner for each selected issue and set a target milestone.
          4. Leave a status comment to re-engage reporters and contributors.
          EOF
            echo "used_fallback=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Create or update weekly summary issue
        if: steps.collect.outputs.issues_enabled == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          NOW_UTC="$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')"

          cat > summary_comment.md <<EOF
          ## Weekly report (${NOW_UTC})

          - Cutoff date (created before): \`${{ steps.collect.outputs.cutoff_date }}\`
          - Issues considered: \`${{ steps.collect.outputs.issue_count }}\`
          - Model: \`${REPORT_MODEL}\`
          - Deterministic fallback used: \`${{ steps.summarize.outputs.used_fallback }}\`

          $(cat ai_summary.md)
          EOF

          ISSUE_NUMBER="$(
            gh issue list --repo "$REPO" --state open --limit 200 --json number,title \
            | jq -r --arg t "$SUMMARY_ISSUE_TITLE" '.[] | select(.title == $t) | .number' \
            | awk 'NR==1'
          )"

          if [ -n "$ISSUE_NUMBER" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO_REPORT_ISSUE_CREATION" --body-file summary_comment.md
          else
            cat > summary_issue_body.md <<EOF
          This issue tracks a weekly summary for open issues older than 4 years.

          $(cat summary_comment.md)
          EOF
            gh issue create --repo "$REPO_REPORT_ISSUE_CREATION" --title "$SUMMARY_ISSUE_TITLE" --body-file summary_issue_body.md
          fi

      - name: Report skipped run when issues are disabled
        if: steps.collect.outputs.issues_enabled != 'true'
        run: echo "Repository issues are disabled. Enable Issues to use this workflow."
